prompts.bomb: Use case: style-transfer. Edit image1 into a replacement match-3 BOMB sprite, styled precisely like the board gems in image2 and image3. Keep a round bomb silhouette and short burning fuse, but remove ALL tiny filigree, grains, scratches and realistic metal textures. Use a large amber faceted round body like the gold gem, thick smooth dark-gold bevel, ONE simple embossed fleur-de-lis symbol, one dark navy collar and short stub fuse with tiny orange tip. Broad hand-painted flat color planes with strong light top-left, very few large highlights, bold clean silhouette. Front facing, minimal depth. This must read at 48px beside the reference gems. Body fills 80% of square, fuse within 90%, even narrow transparent margins. True transparent RGBA background, no wood/background from reference2/3, no shadows outside the silhouette, no glow cloud, no lettering, no numbers. Single isolated entire game piece.
prompts.line: Use case: style-transfer. Edit image1 into a replacement horizontal DIRECTIONAL match-3 sapphire sprite. Match the large simple faceted blue gem in image2 and restrained embossed detail of image3. Remove scrollwork and complex gold cages. cratePrompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit image1 into a REINFORCED CRATE blocker game sprite matching the clean hand-painted gem style of image2 and image3. stages.name: crate_damaged
stages.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create the ONE-HIT-REMAINING damaged version of this exact crate sprite. Keep identical canvas, front view, placement, overall size, color palette and hand-painted broad highlights. Remove most of BOTH gold vertical reinforcement bands, leaving only small snapped metal stubs at top and bottom corners. Expose the broad wooden planks; split the central plank with one large jagged diagonal dark crack through its fleur-de-lis. Chip one corner visibly, but keep a recognizable complete wooden crate blocking the cell. This state must look clearly less reinforced at 48px. No floating fragments, no glow, no additional decoration, no numbers or text. Preserve true transparent background and entire unclipped silhouette.

stages.name: ice
stages.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Replace image1 with a simple intact TWO-HIT ICE SHELL blocker that belongs with the sapphire gem in image2. Front-facing square with clipped corners, broad pale cyan beveled crystalline edge, thick smooth translucent frost panel center, only three broad white glints on top-left. No fractures in intact state. No realistic frosty grain, microcracks, snowflakes, speckle or ornaments. Clean hand-painted broad facet style, confident blue outline. Central panel translucent alpha so a gem behind remains discernible, but edges opaque. Full square occupies 88% of canvas, even transparent margins. True RGBA transparency outside, no backdrop, no text/numbers/shadow, no enclosed gem. One single whole isolated sprite.
